stories.situation: Downsizing from their Thornhill home to something better suited to the next stage of their lives.
Ready for a lifestyle change, Glyn decided to move south of Thornhill to be closer to her family.
After five decades in her Thornhill home, Cynthia decided to downsize and move closer to her grandchildren and great-grandson.
With two teenage sons heading to college and university, they began planning a downsize from their 2,800 square foot home.
Linda was moving into a retirement residence. The family wanted to sell her long-time home quickly to fund her new retirement lifestyle.
